name: template-attribute-value-like-an-event-handler
description: An html/template set reads a value whole only when a template holds an event-handler attribute: text inside another attribute's value that looks like one is no attribute, so the engine reads only the fields the templates name, and a field none names is reported.
pending: the start-tag rule of encoding-reflection: the Go analyzer finds an event-handler attribute by a regular expression that matches attribute values.
